audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was given to Neeko and Level 2 hedged, while whys[0] says 'you are already winning' at 1 and whys[1] says you E-taunt freely at 2. Level 3 was Shen while whys[2] calls it skill-dependent, and First item was Shen while whys[5] says neither side gets a decisive edge.
audit.why: Packet chart is Shen, Shen, Skill, Shen, Neeko, Skill, Shen and it matches the written reasoning row for row; the mirror already set the First-item row to Skill on Neeko's side.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 5 set as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Spikes read right: Shadow Dash at 2, the Tangle-Barbs rhythm at 4-5, Pop Blossom (120/105/90s) at 6, and MR items at two items. Tangle-Barbs cooldown corrected within them.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Inborn Glamour' is a fabricated ability name, and it was credited with empowering her autos. Tangle-Barbs was quoted as a flat 10-second cooldown at all ranks.
audit.why: Her passive is Inherent Glamour and it is the disguise, not an auto-empower — the every-third-attack bonus damage belongs to Shapesplitter (W). Tangle-Barbs (E, 1000 range) is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, so 10s is rank 5 only. Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not spells: Blooming Burst lands through the zone. Pop Blossom's wind-up is hidden only while she is disguised, and immobilizing CC breaks the disguise.
audit.corrected: Fabricated name removed, Shapesplitter credited, rank-1 cooldown used, and the disguise/CC tell stated.

edits.before: W-block her empowered Inborn Glamour auto-attacks and Q follow-up damage inside Spirit's Refuge
edits.after: W-block her Shapesplitter third-attack proc — Spirit's Refuge stops autos, never Blooming Burst

edits.before: With Tangle-Barbs on its 10-second cooldown you can safely dash and pull the blade through her; she has no answer to a committed E-Q-W combo once the root is spent.
edits.after: With Tangle-Barbs spent (12s at rank 1) you can dash and pull the blade through her; she has no answer to a committed E-Q-W combo until that root comes back.

edits.before: Neeko's Tangle-Barbs cooldown sits at 10 seconds — all of your trading windows open on that timer, not hers.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs runs 12s at rank 1 and 10s at rank 5 — every trading window you get opens on that timer.

edits.before: Neeko's R (Pop Blossom) can one-shot you if she hides in the wave and channels unseen — her biggest threat window before you get MR.
edits.after: Pop Blossom's wind-up is hidden only while she is disguised, and CC breaks the disguise — buy magic resist before this window.

edits.before: With Sunfire Aegis or Heartsteel into Hollow Radiance your magic resistance swallows Neeko's entire Q-poke budget. She becomes a glass cannon who dies the moment you land E-taunt — Spirit's Refuge blocks her Inborn Glamour-empowered autos and Q follow-up, Ki Barrier absorbs her burst, and she has nowhere to go without a dash. Keep threatening the 1v1 to zone her off objectives while your Stand United swings teamfights she cannot follow. The only way she wins late is a picked-off low-HP Shen caught without Flash — never walk through brush alone in her range.
edits.after: With Sunfire Aegis or Heartsteel into Hollow Radiance your magic resistance swallows Neeko's entire Q-poke budget. She becomes a glass cannon who dies the moment you land E-taunt — Spirit's Refuge blocks her Shapesplitter autos but never Blooming Burst, Ki Barrier absorbs her burst, and she has nowhere to go without a dash. Keep threatening the 1v1 to zone her off objectives while your Stand United swings teamfights she cannot follow. The only way she wins late is a picked-off low-HP Shen caught without Flash — never walk through brush alone in her range.

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are a rhythm game built around Tangle-Barbs: her root is a 10-second cooldown and every trade window you want opens the instant it goes down. She cannot stop your E-taunt if you bait the root first — let her throw it into the wave or at a minion, then dash in, activate Spirit's Refuge to block her auto-attack retaliation, and pull the spirit blade through her with Q. At level 6 respect her Pop Blossom: she will try to hide in the wave, channel unseen, and jump-burst you — keep enough distance that you can see the channel animation, and never let your HP drop low enough that a full R combo is lethal. Your own level-6 Stand United is stronger long-term but worse in a local duel, so use it on a threatened ally rather than forcing a solo kill here.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are a rhythm game built around Tangle-Barbs: her root is 12s at rank 1 and every trade window you want opens the instant it goes down. She cannot stop your E-taunt if you bait the root first — let her throw it into the wave or at a minion, then dash in, activate Spirit's Refuge to block her auto-attack retaliation, and pull the spirit blade through her with Q. At level 6 respect Pop Blossom: while she is disguised the wind-up is hidden, so break the disguise with your taunt and never sit low enough for a full R combo to be lethal. Your own level-6 Stand United is stronger long-term but worse in a local duel, so use it on a threatened ally rather than forcing a solo kill here.

notes: 'Inborn Glamour' was a fabricated name for Inherent Glamour, and it was also given the wrong effect — the third-attack damage is Shapesplitter (W); Inherent Glamour is the disguise. The packet flagged 'Use Stand United' as suspect; that is a false positive. Some content-layer lines on this matchup are still written in first person (flagged by the mirror audit); I converted only the lines I had a factual reason to touch.
